title: D1 Sessions API: withSession()/getBookmark() round-trip through the local data plane (null before a query, monotonic bookmarks, resume from a bookmark, first-primary/first-unconstrained)
evidence: https://developers.cloudflare.com/d1/worker-api/d1-database/#withsession (withSession(constraint|bookmark): first-primary / first-unconstrained / bookmark; D1DatabaseSession adds getBookmark(), prepare(), batch())

https://developers.cloudflare.com/d1/worker-api/d1-database/#getbookmark (getBookmark(): String | null — "returns null if no query is executed within a Session", else the latest bookmark seen by the last query)

https://github.com/cloudflare/workerd/blob/7545be644952d71d76b904b37ae71b10c0ba8cad/src/cloudflare/internal/d1-api.ts (session sends x-cf-d1-session-commit-token, keeps the max response token by localeCompare, and returns null while only a constraint is held)
vrt-provider/src/d1.rs + vrt-provider/src/server.rs (x-cf-d1-* request headers forwarded to vrt-sql; its x-cf-d1-session-commit-token response header passed back)
vrt-sql/src/wire.rs (every successful /query|/execute signs a bookmark from the engine's commit_lsn)

steps.name: bookmark lifecycle: null before a query, resume, monotonic advance, constraints, session batch()
